about: EXPRESSIBILITY corpus for scanner composition. It measures whether a VALID SPEC EXISTS for a request, run through the real validator. It does NOT measure whether any model produces that spec, and it says nothing about planner accuracy. No model runs here. A gold spec is one hand-written reading of a request; another trader could read the same words differently.
split_rule: sha256(text) mod 3 == 0 is held_out, else design. Mechanical, so nobody chose which requests went where. The same author wrote both sets, so held_out is not blind: read it as a generalisation check on primitives chosen from design, not as independent evaluation.

reasons.engine_primitive_missing: no catalog field or combination says it
reasons.agent_schema_narrower: the engine can say it; the Agent's screener.run schema cannot, or SC-1 refuses it by owner decision
reasons.f16_hidden: F-16: refused by the real validator, never substituted
